periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, angled approximately 45 degrees inward and downward toward the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Vertical oval/ellipsoid elongation with a height-to-width ratio greater than 1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering, creating a teardrop-shaped profile with the geometric center positioned above the midpoint of the vertical axis.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow, broad U-shaped curve across the posterior edge of the dark transverse band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High thickness, occupying approximately 40% of the visible dorsal torso area.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide horizontal separation across the cranial vault, approximately 1.5 times the width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Continuously smooth, semicircular convex curvature at the apex.
